verified_facts.text: Triple Creek Ranch is set in the Bitterroot Mountain Range of the Montana Rockies.
verified_facts.excerpt: set in the heart of the breathtaking Bitterroot Mountain Range of the Montana Rockies

verified_facts.text: Triple Creek Ranch has been a Montana hideaway since 1986.
verified_facts.excerpt: A Montana Hideaway’ – Since 1986

verified_facts.text: Triple Creek Ranch has been a member of Relais & Chateaux since 1996.
verified_facts.excerpt: A proud member of the prestigious Relais & Châteaux since 1996

verified_facts.text: Accommodations are private log ranch cabins and ranch homes with easy access to the lodge.
verified_facts.excerpt: private log luxury ranch cabins and splendid ranch homes with easy access to our well-appointed and comfortable lodge

verified_facts.text: Cabins range from secluded spots in the pines or on the banks of the Bitterroot River to cabins close to the lodge and the outdoor pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Are you seeking a secluded cabin nestled in the pines, or on the banks of the Bitterroot River? Or, perhaps you prefer to be close to the inviting bustle of the Lodge and just steps away from the outdoor pool.

verified_facts.text: The lodge and grounds feature a curated collection of original Western art.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our lodge and surroundings feature a curated collection of original Western art

verified_facts.text: Nightly cabin rates include meals, beverages and most activities and are designed for two people.
verified_facts.excerpt: inclusive of meals, beverages and most activities, and are designed for two people

verified_facts.text: Horseback riding, hiking, snowshoeing, a fly-casting clinic, mountain biking, archery, sapphire panning and tennis are included in the nightly cabin rate.
verified_facts.excerpt: Fill your day with activities such as horseback riding, hiking or snowshoeing, a fly-casting clinic, mountain biking, archery, sapphire panning, or a game of tennis, all of which is included in your nightly cabin rate.

verified_facts.text: Horseback riding is a year-round activity at Triple Creek Ranch.
verified_facts.excerpt: horseback riding at Triple Creek Ranch is a year-round activity

verified_facts.text: Experienced wranglers accompany all horseback trips and trail ride groups are kept small.
verified_facts.excerpt: experienced wranglers accompany all horseback trips. Trail ride group sizes are kept small

verified_facts.text: The guided Scenic Drive tours the CB Ranch and Bitterroot Valley in search of wildlife such as elk, mule deer, whitetail and bison.
verified_facts.excerpt: discover the local herds of elk, mule deer, whitetail and bison on the horizon

verified_facts.text: Guests can float the Bitterroot River with an experienced fly-fishing guide, and all fishing there is catch and release.
verified_facts.excerpt: float with an experienced guide down the Bitterroot River

verified_facts.text: Group yoga and meditation classes are offered most days and held outdoors as often as weather allows.
verified_facts.excerpt: Classes are offered most days, and held outdoors as often as weather and temperatures allow.

verified_facts.text: Lost Trail Powder Mountain Ski Area is about a 30 minute drive from the ranch, on the Continental Divide at the Montana-Idaho border.
verified_facts.excerpt: skiing or boarding the Continental Divide on the Montana-Idaho border. Only a short 30 minute drive from the ranch

verified_facts.text: Guests can relax in a hot tub or nap in a hammock in the shade of the pines.
verified_facts.excerpt: Read for pure pleasure, relax in a hot tub or nap on a hammock in the shade of the whispering pines.

verified_facts.text: Executive Chef Jacob Leatherman introduces a new menu daily highlighting local terroir.
verified_facts.excerpt: Introducing an inventive new menu daily

verified_facts.text: Meals are served in the vaulted-ceiling Dining Room or delivered to the cabin, and the dress code is ranch casual.
verified_facts.excerpt: Meals are served in our magnificent vaulted-ceiling Dining Room, or guests may request a Cabin delivery at no additional cost. The dress code is best described as “ranch casual.”

verified_facts.text: Add-on adventures such as guided fly-fishing, scenic river floating, cattle drives, whitewater rafting and ATV tours carry additional fees.
verified_facts.excerpt: We are also happy to help you plan for add-on adventures (additional fees apply) of guided fly-fishing, scenic river floating, driving cattle to greener pasture, whitewater rafting, or guided all-terrain vehicle tours.

verified_facts.text: May and June can bring high water on the Bitterroot with limited fishing and float availability due to snow melt.
verified_facts.excerpt: the months of May and June can be high water with limited fishing and scenic float availability due to snow melt

verified_facts.text: For safety, the ranch cannot accept horseback riders over 250 lbs.
verified_facts.excerpt: for the safety of our guests and horses we cannot accept riders over 250 lbs

verified_facts.text: Dog sledding is offered at a meeting point a short drive from the ranch, subject to minimum snowfall.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience availability subject to minimum snowfall requirement.
